---
title: "Folder Tree and Ownership Boundaries"
---

## Intended repository tree

```text
scgsim/
├── README.md                 # Package-owned project entry
├── _quarto.yml               # Package documentation navigation
├── docs/                     # Canonical authored usage/contract sources
├── src/scgsim/               # SCGSim Development-owned product source
├── schemas/                  # SCGSim Development-owned product schemas
├── scripts/                  # SCGSim Development-owned producers/tooling
└── tests/                    # SCGSim Development-owned stabilization tests
```

Generated site output is never source authority.

## Responsibility map

| Owner | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| SCGSim Development | Package/build/runtime/report source, usage documentation, schemas, tests, scripts, CI/release, and generated knowledge/API-reference producers |
| OrPen SC PDK | Public PDK facts, public Component source, and public component-simulation notebooks |
| Documentation contributors | Exact delegated prose paths and writing-quality review; no solver/API/scientific semantic decisions |
| Chip Design EPR | Surface-EPR requirements and private consumer validation only |
| Integration & Sync | Repository settings, merges, future pins, synchronization, and cleanup |

The package owns its version-bound usage knowledge. Documentation contributors
may author an exact leased path; a separate documentation handoff is not
required for package-owned prose. Generated offline knowledge is derived from
the same editable documentation sources, not a second set of recipes. No owner listed here may
infer Human acceptance, publication authority, or merge authority from a green
build.
